PostHog dual-send via a same-origin proxy

First-party /api/analytics stays the system of record; PostHog mirrors it. Toggle the middleware fix below to see the silent-drop this integration would otherwise have shipped with.

next build --webpack exit 0, then next start, live against PostHog EU. The requestId is a real response, not a mock.

Why the proxy is load-bearing, not a nicety

next.config.mjs CSP:   script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'      (no external hosts)

  posthog-js from   https://eu-assets.i.posthog.com/...   ->  BLOCKED by CSP
  posthog-js from   /ingest/static/...  (same origin)     ->  allowed

In mandat the same proxy exists to survive ad blockers.
Here it is the only way the SDK loads at all.
